levels.surface: الحسن بن علي بن أبي حمزة البطائني

notes: «وَ بِهَذَا الْإِسْنَادِ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ» : prev1 has no written chain, so prev2 supplies the names before Ahmad (أبي, سعد بن عبد الله), taken as inherited; Ahmad onward is this report's own; «قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ» names the Imam in the words after the chain, so he is the last item (owner ruling 2); the «بهذا الإسناد» phrase is not also written as a back reference
